# Vendored geometry codec

meshoptimizer 1.3.0, installed from its official npm package. Source: https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer/tree/v1.3/js . The decoder contains its WebAssembly binary and works offline without a CDN. Only the decoder is bundled into the browser worker; the encoder is used during packaging. No quantization or mesh simplification is used. See MESHOPTIMIZER_LICENSE.txt.
